title: Two sum indices
statement_markdown:
Implement `two_sum` with parameters `nums: list[int]`, `target: int`.

Return a `list` (`list[int]`). Find distinct indices i < j with nums[i] + nums[j] == target. Return [i, j]. If several pairs work, choose the smallest j, then the smallest i. Do not modify nums.

No solution: Return an empty list []. Never reuse one index.

Exceptions: Inputs satisfy the declared constraints; no exception is expected.
constraints: Every nums element is an integer between -1000000000 and 1000000000 inclusive.
target is an integer between -2000000000 and 2000000000 inclusive.
A valid pair is not guaranteed.

examples.explanation: Use two distinct positions; their values sum to target.
Use two distinct positions; their values sum to target.

explanation: Scan increasing j. Before storing nums[j], look up its complement among earlier values. Keeping the first index for each value gives the smallest i for that j. Checking before insertion prevents reusing an index. If no match appears, return []. For [1, 1, 2] and target 3, keep index 0 for value 1 and return [0, 2].
complexity: Expected O(n) time with dictionary lookups and O(n) extra space. The input list is unchanged.
